mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SRCH_LOG (APP_ID, SEC_ID, SRCH_DT, SRCH_KEYWORD, RES_COUNT, ELAPSE) VALUES (#{appId}, #{secId}, #{srchDt}, #{srchKeyword}, #{resCount}, #{elapse})
mapper.select: SELECT SRCH_KEYWORD as keyword, COUNT(*) as count FROM TB_SRCH_LOG WHERE APP_ID = #{appId} AND SRCH_DT >= NOW() - INTERVAL #{period} DAY GROUP BY SRCH_KEYWORD ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{size}
